title: carlina graeca var. rothii
intro: Carlina graeca var. rothii, commonly known as Roth's carline thistle, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family and is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress and infections. The therapeutic actions of Carlina graeca var. rothii include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
